## 3dslibris 3.1.0

Update focused on performance and speed: quicker startup and library browsing, faster book preparation, and smoother reading, search and zoom controls.

### Fixes and improvements

- **Startup:** quicker app initialization before the library appears (measured about 50% less time before the first library draw).
- **Library:** quicker navigation, folder changes and cover loading, with less repeated work when sorting by title or author. Saved thumbnails are reused when returning from a book. Large JPEG covers, including higher-resolution EPUB covers previously rejected, decode at reduced resolution on 3DS to avoid a full-size RGB memory spike.
- **Opening books:** faster EPUB preparation, lighter MOBI loading and less unnecessary work when reopening cached EPUBs (measured about 30–40% less time preparing EPUB books). Loading-screen progress waits for the display refresh before reusing its buffers to prevent overlapping redraws. Late font and decoder diagnostics no longer draw over the loading screen.
- **EPUB cache saving:** split large page and search records between idle writes so they respect the save budget instead of forcing a whole record into one update. Existing page caches remain compatible.
- **Reading:** quicker page turns and redraws, including centered/right-aligned text, code and footnotes (measured **about 80% less time** in the sampled EPUB page turns).
- **PDF/XPS:** GPU-accelerated pan and zoom, reusing loaded page images to keep movement smooth and text sharp. Zooming out can reuse the existing image without rendering the page again. GPU uploads now read decoded pixels directly, avoiding a full intermediate RGB565 bitmap.
- **CBZ:** GPU-accelerated pan and zoom with fewer repeated decodes. Loaded-page zoom changes took about 17 ms instead of 110 ms in two matching examples (about 6.5× faster). Texture preparation also avoids a full intermediate RGB565 bitmap.
- **PDF/CBZ panning:** update the preview more efficiently while dragging and keep the clock and page counter visible.
- **Wide and orientation:** GPU rendering supports Wide top-screen mode where available and all three reading orientations, with automatic software fallback when GPU rendering is unavailable or memory is insufficient.
- **Library preload:** choose `preload book data` in GENERAL settings to prepare metadata and covers across the root and its visible folders. Reuses valid caches, saves each result immediately and offers cancellation between operations. Manually preloaded covers stay on SD across restarts until the cache is cleared, without retaining them all in RAM. A second run reuses saved data; no reading pages are prepared. Completion now replaces the progress display with a prominent summary and an explicit return-to-settings button.
- **Library search:** press `Y` or choose `search` in general settings to find books/folders by filename, or books by genuine title or author. Filename search needs no metadata preparation. Title/author preparation is cached together, works across the existing single folder level, and reports incomplete searches. No manual cache clearing is needed.
- **Search:** quicker searches for words and phrases (measured **about 90% less time** searching a full 405-page book with no match).
- **Illustrations:** GPU-accelerated full-screen image viewing in EPUB, MOBI and FB2, with quicker repeated zoom and pan, efficient preview updates and steady controls. The full-screen viewer releases its CPU bitmap once textures and the preview are ready, recovering it if software fallback is needed. Opaque inline images use half the cached pixel memory.
- **Illustration rotation:** physical `L` / `R` or two touch buttons rotate EPUB/MOBI/FB2 illustrations by 90°. Zoom and center are preserved within viewport bounds, the overview and controls follow the rotation, and resident GPU textures are reused when their resolution is sufficient. The eight touch actions fit in two rows. `X` fits and centers without resetting the angle.
- Restore bookmarks without duplicating them and keep custom font selections when starting the app.

**Page loading:** the latest loading optimizations reduced complete PDF page changes from about 625 to 502 ms on average across 12 matching transitions (**about 20% less time than the initial GPU build**). Texture preparation and upload dropped from about 185 to 50 ms for 480×678 PDF images (**3.7× faster**) and from 404 to 133 ms for 784×1145 CBZ images (**3× faster**). These gains reduce the cost of preparing new GPU images; they do not represent faster MuPDF rasterization. The matched PDF page-change average remains above the earlier software renderer's 408 ms.

Measurements come from Azahar debug comparisons; results vary by book and device. Physical validation on New Nintendo 2DS XL and Nintendo 3DS XL is pending. The CBZ zoom figures are based on two matching examples, and XPS has not been measured separately.

### Updating

Reading progress, bookmarks and preferences are kept. No manual cache clearing is needed.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone trying the builds and reporting issues. You can support the project with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
